elector.definition: n. any of the German princes who were entitled to vote in the election of new emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
elector.translation:
n. 有选举权的人, 选举人
[法] 有选举权者, 合格选举人

electoral.definition:
a. of or relating to elections
s. relating to or composed of electors
electoral.translation:
a. 选举人的, 选举的, (有关)选举的
[法] 选举的, 选举人的, 由选举人组成的

electorally.translation: adv. 从选举方面来讲（electoral的副词形式）

electorate.definition: n. the body of enfranchised citizens; those qualified to vote
electorate.translation:
n. 选民, 有选举权者, 选区
[法] 选民, 选举团, 选区

electorates.definition: n. the body of enfranchised citizens; those qualified to vote
electorates.translation: n. 全体选民( electorate的复数形式 )

electors.definition:
n. a citizen who has a legal right to vote
n. any of the German princes who were entitled to vote in the election of new emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
electors.translation: n. 有选举权的人, 选民( elector的复数形式 )

electorship.definition: n. The office or status of an elector.
electorship.translation: n. (美国)选举团成员的地位(或官职)
